typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> TBLTNHLCCSOEXTRACT
TBLTNHLCCSOEXTRACT sink(input(
		SUBSCR_ID as string,
		TO_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PCP_PROV_NM as string,
		TNHL_TIN as string,
		FROM_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TNHL_NAME as string,
		PROC_ID as string,
		PCP_PROV_TIN as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SUBSCR_ID,
		TO_DT,
		PCP_PROV_NM,
		TNHL_TIN,
		FROM_DT,
		TNHL_NAME,
		PROC_ID,
		PCP_PROV_TIN)) ~> AMGWCCFTENROLLMENTFEED
